Imec and EV Group demonstrate wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding with 200nm interconnect pitch and record high overlay accuracy

LEUVEN (Belgium), MAY 28, 2026— This week, at the 2026 IEEE Electronic Components and Technology Conference (ECTC), imec, a world-leading research and innovation hub in advanced semiconductor technologies, and EV Group (EVG), leading provider of semiconductor manufacturing equipment and process solutions, present a robust and highly yielding wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding technology at 200nm Cu interconnect pad pitch, demonstrated on a test vehicle with routable interconnects. In addition, a record high Cu pad alignment accuracy was achieved, leveraging EVG’s most advanced wafer bonding equipment. Imec and EVG intend to further advance the wafer-to-wafer hybrid bonding roadmap, in support of logic-to-logic and memory-to-logic tier stacking use cases that require an extremely high level of interconnect density – as envisioned in imec’s CMOS 2.0 scaling paradigm.

Xanadu and EV Group partner to build industrial-scale photonic quantum hardware

Toronto, ON | May 5th, 2026 /CNW/ -- Xanadu Quantum Technologies Ltd. (“Xanadu”; NASDAQ/TSX: XNDU), a leading photonic quantum computing company, and EV Group (EVG), a leading supplier of wafer bonding and lithography equipment, today announced a strategic partnership to develop critical heterogeneous integration and wafer bonding processes to facilitate the scalability of photonic quantum systems. Throughout this partnership, Xanadu and EVG expect to utilize EVG’s industrial manufacturing tools to fabricate the specialized chips used in Xanadu’s photonic quantum computers, with the goal of accelerating the progression of quantum computing chip manufacturing from the lab to high-volume production.

Los Angeles, California, March 17, 2026 – Source Photonics Inc., a leading global provider of innovative and reliable technology solutions for communications and data connectivity for use in hyperscale and AI datacenters, today announced to jointly conduct a live demonstration of 1.6T Transceiver product family and 1.6T Ethernet Switch platform together with Delta Electronics, a global leader in power and thermal management technologies, at OFC’26, the premier and largest global conference and exhibition for optical communications and networking professionals.

Delta’s DC-9064O is a 102.4T Ethernet switch for the 1.6TbE generation, offers 224G/lane signaling, delivering ultra-low latency and exceptional thermal efficiency for AI and GPU based ecosystems.

Delta DC-9064O Product Highlights:
• 64 port 1.6TbE Broadcom TH6 BCM78914 switch up to 102.4Tbps of bandwidth
• Powered by a pair of 4.5kW power supplies and supports up to 30W OSFP
• Support LRO/LPO modules using next gen ultra lossless PCB materials
• Proven interoperability with 1.6T EML and Sipho based transceivers
• Delivers best-in-class module performance in BER and power consumption
• Compliant to all IEEE and OIF standards, capable of supporting LR links on the chip to module electrical interface
• Support air cooled and liquid cooled versions

Source Photonics began production shipments of 100G single lambda PAM4 based 100G/400G transceivers when 400G industry adoption start to take off from 2021, and over 20 million high speed 53GBd EML chips have been shipped so far. The newly released product-grade 100GBd EMLs enable 200Gb/s single lambda PAM4 signaling for shipping 1.6T and 800G transceivers. The optical modules leverage self-developed 200G PAM4 EML lasers around O band, including CWDM wavelengths of 1271nm/1291nm/1311nm/1331nm and LWDM wavelengths at 1295.5nm/ 1300.0nm/1304.5nm/1309.1nm.

Source Photonics’ latest 1.6T product series includes DR8, 2×FR4, 2×LR4 optical modules and AEC copper cables, and the 800G product series includes DR4, FR4, and LR4 modules based on single-lambda 200G in form of either OSFP or QSFP-DD form factors covering multiple optical connector and interface options. The multiple variants of EML, and Silicon Photonics are available in production volume for the 1.6T DR8 product types. This represents a critical milestone to commercialize next generation 102.4T switch platforms for accelerated AI compute infrastructures.

Highlight Source Photonics 1.6T Products for traffic tests:
• 1.6T DR8/2×FR4/2×LR4 (EML)
• 1.6T DR8/2×FR4 (Sipho)
• 1.6T DR8 EBO (EML)
• 1.6T LRO DR8 (SiPho)

Source Photonics began production shipments of 100G single lambda PAM4 based 100G/400G transceivers when 400G industry adoption start to take off from 2021. The 100GBd EMLs enable 200Gb/s single lambda PAM4 signaling for shipping 1.6T and 800G transceivers. The optical modules leverage 200G PAM4 EML lasers around O band, including CWDM wavelengths of 1271nm/1291nm/1311nm/1331nm and LWDM wavelengths at 1295.5nm/ 1300.0nm/1304.5nm/1309.1nm.

 

Source Photonics’ latest 1.6T product series includes DR8, 2xFR4 optical modules and DAC/ACC copper cables, and the 800G product series includes DR4, FR4, and LR4 modules based on single-lambda 200G in form of either OSFP or QSFP-DD form factors covering multiple optical connector and interface options. The multiple variants of EML, Silicon Photonics and InP PIC solutions are available for the 1.6T DR8 product types. This represents a critical milestone to enable next generation 51.2T and 102.4T switch platforms for accelerated AI compute infrastructure.

Source Photonics Unveil the Tri-mode 50G PON OLT SFP-DD Optical Transceivers with Live Demonstration during OFC’25

 

West Hills and San Francisco, California, April 1, 2025 – Source Photonics Inc., a leading global provider of innovative and reliable technology solutions for communications and data connectivity for use in hyperscale and AI datacenters, today announces the release of its small form factor, low-power solution for the next generation high-speed PON networks – the 50G PON OLT SFP-DD. This SFP-DD product leverages industry-leading optoelectronic chip technology with live demonstration to support downstream optical bandwidth of up to 50G NRZ signals and upstream optical/electrical interface line rates of up to 25G burst reception, support XGS-PON/50G dual-mode and GPON/XG(S)-PON/50G-PON tri-mode co-existence. The optical power budget is designed to cover or be compatible with existing ODN networks. This solution will help operators maximize the value of fiber optics, achieving next-generation bandwidth upgrades while balancing network evolution and cost, further advancing the development of broadband optical access.

 

With the initiation of F5G-A and China’s “Double 10G Strategies,” large-scale deployment of 50G PON is on the verge of taking off. The 50G PON OLT optical module features the smallest SFP-DD packaging to increase the number of ports per line card for customers, allowing network upgrades without changing the layout of equipment rooms or the number of devices. The product supports industrial-grade temperatures to meet the demands of network deployment in harsh telecommunication environments.

During live demonstration, the Rx burst mode sensitivity was tested below <-28.5dBm under loud-soft environment with stronger Tx reference at -13dBm or higher. These are very competitive results to support existing ODN use cases with good performance margin. Currently, Source Photonics has initiated technical dialogues and sample testing of this product with leading global PON network equipment manufacturers.
